02 / Bespoke Manufacturing · Private Labelling
Turnkey Brand Enablement

From Concept to Your Finished Label.

We specialize in 100% third-party and contract manufacturing, empowering clients to market proprietary formulations without managing complex factory infrastructure.

1

Formulation R&D

Active ingredient ratio balancing, flavour profiling, solubility optimization, and custom nutritional profile development tailored to your target consumer demographic.

2

Quality Sourcing

Certified raw material procurement with strict Certificate of Analysis (CoA) validation, active assay verification, and heavy metal screening for total peace of mind.

3

Packaging Architecture

Container selection (HDPE jars, blister packs, composite sachets, amber droppers), graphic label compliance, tamper-evident seals, and protective export barrier design.

4

Pilot Batch Testing

Pilot blend trials, organoleptic assessments, dissolution/disintegration testing, and real-time stability verification before full commercial run sign-off.

5

Cleanroom Production

High-speed automated blending, tableting, encapsulation, and filling in controlled cleanrooms adhering to stringent international hygiene protocols.

6

Global Export Logistics

Batch test certification, export documentation (Free Sale, Certificate of Origin, Legalization), palletization, and dispatch to maritime ports and air hubs.

Your Brand Equity, Defended by Process Excellence

Whether you are an established international sports brand seeking diversified supply lines or a modern direct-to-consumer founder entering the wellness sphere, our contract infrastructure provides low capital friction, flexible batch planning, and guaranteed formula confidentiality.

05 / Research & Quality · Scientific Integrity
Scientific Rigour & Verification

Care in the Process. Confidence in the Product.

What goes into a nutritional product matters just as much as the brand label upon it. Our multi-tiered quality assurance protocols protect brand integrity at every stage.

IT STARTS WITH A QUESTION. It Grows with Good Science.

01 / Raw Material Quarantine & Assay

Every incoming botanical, amino acid, and vitamin lot is quarantined until identity, purity, potency, moisture, and microbial compliance are chemically certified.

02 / Environmental Cleanroom Controls

HEPA-filtered air handling, positive air pressure differentials, temperature, and relative humidity regulation ensure zero cross-contamination.

03 / In-Process Variance Mitigation

Dedicated QA auditors conduct regular weight variation, disintegration, blend uniformity, and torque checks throughout active production shifts.

04 / Full Batch Traceability & CoA

Every commercial batch is linked to complete batch production records (BPR), retention samples, and comprehensive Certificates of Analysis.

The Gomzi Advantage
